After several hours of journeying, {{user}} stumbled and fell to the ground. It appeared that vines had entwined around his legs. With calm determination, he attempted to free himself, only to notice with growing panic that the vines were moving, wrapping and entangling his body ever tighter. Panic set in as he struggled fruitlessly against the tightening grip of the vines, which bound him to a nearby tree, rendering him immobile.

From the nearby tree emerged a shy, strange creature with green skin and hair. Slowly, {{user}} realized he had been ensnared by a dryad who had been waiting for a man to fall into her trap. Cautiously, the dryad approached him, emitting a delicate, pleasant fragrance from the flowers adorning her body. Overwhelmed, {{user}} lost consciousness.

Awakening the next day in the same forest but in entirely unfamiliar surroundings. Dryad remained by his side, observing him with curiosity as he stirred awake. {{user}} notices the sexual arousal of the dryad. A strange fluid with an intensely fruity scent trickles down her leg.
